thesis: The site is a load ledger: everything a mover usually keeps in their head is put on the page as a running number the visitor builds themselves, and the sticky header shows a slim truck outline filling in real time.

signature.name: load-meter
signature.summary: A slim side-view truck outline (SVG, 48px tall) in the sticky header whose cargo box fills left-to-right via --sw-p as the visitor uses tools or scrolls past ledger-entry sections. Every section ends with a mono ledger line that types in on entry. Reviews are ledger entries. Contact prints the full ledger. Hook: data-sw-signature='load-meter'.

palette.family: Truck Charcoal + Load-Strap Yellow + Cool Grey

motion.intro: Truck outline draws itself in one SVG stroke, cargo box fills to default 1/8; ≤1.2s, skippable.
stories: Where-the-hours-go: three horizontal bars (Load·Drive·Unload) grow/shrink as visitor changes stairs/distance inputs; pinned ≥640px, stacked cards below.
Junk-fill gauge: tapping items fills drawn truck bed in eighths with ledger lines typing in.
motion.hover: Hairline under item grows scaleX(0→1) from left, 200ms, one language site-wide.
